choices: It reads past the end of the array
Before the loop i is 0, so the invariant claims max is the largest of an empty range
max should be initialized to zero
explanation: The invariant is 'max is the largest of a[0..i-1]', and a[0..-1] is empty — but max was set to a[0], which is not the largest of nothing. Starting the loop at 1 establishes it. The original merely wastes an iteration here; in a loop whose body has a side effect the same misalignment is a real bug.
